how_to_add_a_character: 1) find a natural CC-BY/CC0 reference clip (8-12 s, clean, one speaker; FLEURS/IndicVoices-R) 2) make_reel.py audition 3) lock: copy to voices/<name>.wav and add an entry here with source + licence. Never clone a real person's voice without written consent.
voice_choice_rule: User chooses voices only for major characters (series.json → major_characters). Claude chooses minor characters' voices.
engine_rule: All voices are ElevenLabs (user, Nov 2026). Chatterbox voices stay only on reels already made (A01–A03).
